d.ko: What has 50 amazing chiptune tracks, a loony story mode, 32 different chicken types to fight, and takes you on a tour of all your favorite retro games? It's Old School Musical! Tib and Rob are the heroes of a wacky adventure that will teach them where all of the bugs in our favorite games come from.

d.zh:
共有有50個驚人的Chiptune音軌，一個瘋癫故事模式，32種不同的小雞類戰鬥，而且會讓你享受你最喜歡的複古遊戲，當然是老式音樂劇了！
TIB和Rob是一個古怪的冒險的英雄，他們將告訴你們最喜歡的遊戲中的所有錯誤來自哪裏。
